```artifact
Feature: System Security and Functionality

  Scenario: Chemists and Labs can log into the system
    Given the system is up and running
    When a Chemist or Lab logs in with valid credentials
    Then they should be able to access the Prescriptions

  Scenario: Patients can log into the system
    Given the system is up and running
    When a Patient logs in with valid credentials
    Then they should be able to access their Prescriptions

  Scenario: Emails are sent to Patients including the full prescription and Invoice
    Given a Patient has a valid email address
    When a prescription is generated for the Patient
    Then an email should be sent to the Patient's email address with the full prescription and Invoice

  Scenario: Payments can be securely accepted via Debit/Credit Cards and Net banking
    Given a Patient is logged into the system
    When they click on the payment button
    Then a secure payment interface should be displayed
    And the payment should be processed securely

  Scenario: System is self-contained and no data is shared with any third party
    Given the system is up and running
    When a Chemist or Lab logs in with valid credentials
    Then their data should not be shared with any third party
    And when a Patient logs in with valid credentials
    Then their data should not be shared with any third party

  Scenario: System supports browsers: Google Chrome, Mozilla Firefox, Safari, etc.
    Given the system is up and running
    When a Chemist or Lab logs in with valid credentials using Google Chrome
    Then they should be able to access the Prescriptions
    And when a Patient logs in with valid credentials using Mozilla Firefox
    Then they should be able to access their Prescriptions
    And when a Chemist or Lab logs in with valid credentials using Safari
    Then they should be able to access the Prescriptions

  Scenario: System supports operating systems that support the above browsers
    Given the system is up and running
    When a Chemist or Lab logs in with valid credentials on a Windows machine
    Then they should be able to access the Prescriptions
    And when a Patient logs in with valid credentials on a Mac machine
    Then they should be able to access their Prescriptions
    And when a Chemist or Lab logs in with valid credentials on a Linux machine
    Then they should be able to access the Prescriptions
```
